metadata.title: Zero-surgery characterises Whitehead doubles
metadata.abstract: We show that zero is a characterising slope for the untwisted Whitehead double of any knot $K$. More generally, this holds for all $n$-twisted Whitehead doubles of $K$, with the assumption that $n\ne pq$ if $K$ is a non-trivial $(p,q)$-torus knot or $(p,q)$-cable. In particular, zero is a characterising slope for all twist knots.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 证明 0 是任意 untwisted Whitehead double 的 characterizing slope；对 n-twisted double 排除 torus/cable 特定 n=pq 例外，并覆盖全部 twist knot。
analysis.breakthrough: 建立广泛 satellite knot 的零手术识别性。
analysis.limitations: twisted 情形必须保留 nontrivial torus/cable 对应的例外。
analysis.priorityReason: 建立广泛 satellite knot 的零手术识别性。
